summary: The strategic event journal: a bounded, saved window of StrategicEvents whose evicted prefix is folded into a history digest, so a save never grows without limit and never loses what happened.

coordination.notes: expedition.rs: appends one field at the END of ExpeditionState plus its initialiser at the end of the struct literal in new(), and one hunk inside the thin strategic_tick that journals the events run_hour returns before returning them. Other lanes appending at the same struct tail merge with this. tick.rs is untouched: JournalEntry wraps StrategicEvent, which already derives Clone/Serialize/Deserialize. save_migration.rs: EXPECTED_CURRENT_KEYS gains strategic_journal in struct order; v1_current.json is NOT regenerated, because the card's Done-when is that a fixture predating the field still loads with an empty journal.
coordination.notes_scores: Entries carry only what StrategicEvent carries plus day and hour: no utility scores (S5), no dispositions (S12). The journal is not a side channel.
